limitations: All jobs receive the same verified emitted capture. Shared and restoration qualifiers own their preview. SIM Fresh and listeners use a per-job strict preview on port8774 with fixtureAccess:false; their unchanged document routing rewrites only local HTML access salt, verifier and id. This is an explicit browser fixture exception, not an offline HTML integrity proof.

Existing durable qualifiers only, sequential isolated browsers. No production or harness changes are made by this wrapper. Each selected job runs once; a strict failure remains failed while later independent jobs may proceed only after confirmed browser/server cleanup.

Some durable qualifiers retain empty-stack pageerrors as empty strings; any pageerror still fails their strict count. Raw/name diagnostics require a separate bounded probe after preserving such a failed receipt.

This refresh covers shared controls, Solo readiness/cache ownership and incoming SIM guidance. Full native corpus retains unchanged-content evidence. Representative emitted-offline, control-remap and native discard checks run separately.
The two-hour actual-wall-time rotation and outstanding physical-device/human review checks remain separate.
